SASBDB entry SASDCA3  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDCA3/)

Publication: The C-Terminal Zinc Fingers of ZBTB38 are Novel Selective Readers of DNA Methylation.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jmb.2017.12.014

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDCA3/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
